introHtml: Midweight work shirts balance durability and comfort, making them ideal for year-round wear in warehouses, construction sites, and field service. The heavier fabric resists tearing and holds up to frequent washing, while still breathing enough for active jobs. Choose cotton or poly-cotton blends in your company colors, and add embroidery or screen printing for a professional look. These shirts keep your crew looking sharp without sacrificing toughness.
heroAltText: Custom midweight work shirts in bulk, featuring durable fabric and embroidered logos for uniform apparel.
